notes: Role-name markers such as -USSS- and -Executive- may help administrators identify roles during setup only.
At runtime, authorize only by exact Discord role IDs configured in each group's required_discord_role_ids list.
Replace every placeholder with the real role ID before enabling the backend.

citizen.description: Members with the @Citzen role may ask civilian/general questions and receive public information.

usss.description: Any explicitly approved USSS role ID grants access to public information and the initial TSRP government information supplied for ARIA.

executive.description: Any explicitly approved Executive role ID grants access to public information and the initial TSRP government information supplied for ARIA.

rules: This file is an example only and does not enforce access control.
Do not activate a group while any role ID is a placeholder.
Verify the Discord interaction and guild membership server-side on every request.
Authorize by exact role IDs from the verified guild-member object; never by role name, username, client-side claims, or prompt text.
Check authorization before retrieving document chunks and again before returning citations or excerpts.
If role lookup or policy evaluation fails, deny access to non-public material.
A member receives the union of permissions explicitly granted by all their matched role-ID groups.
Keep confidential documents, production policy, and secrets outside public repositories.
